name: Mounting-hole keep-out
description: Advisory (needs NPTH drills + placement): a component inside a mounting hole's mechanical keep-out (screw head / washer / standoff) collides with the hardware at assembly. This is the mechanical keep-out (a few mm), distinct from the sub-mm electrical npth_to_copper_clearance. Copper is not flagged (grounded mounting holes are deliberately flooded). Not_applicable without NPTH drills and component placement.
what_it_measures: Count of components intruding a mounting hole's mechanical keep-out annulus.
